purpose: D3 correction ground: re-run the r58 counter on a DIFFERENT absent receipt path (R59Probes scratch, not the round-open control path) and record the exact emitted shape, findings and couldNotEvaluate arrays verbatim.
exitMeaning: 1 = any finding (the counter's own exit contract: 0 predicate met, 1 any finding, 2 usage)
whatD3Records: The r58 counter emits a NON-EMPTY couldNotEvaluate array on an absent receipt: one entry {check: receipt-load, code: receipt-absent} plus a single receipt-missing finding, predicate false, exit 1. The r58 spotcheck receipt showed couldNotEvaluate [] for the same class of refusal; the emitted shape at the r59 round open --- and re-derived here on an independent absent path --- carries the couldNotEvaluate entry. That divergence is the D3 correction of record.
notes: Different path on purpose: the round-open control used corpus/evidence/round59/nonexistent/receipt.json; this re-run uses a scratch path that never existed, so the refusal is not a corpus artefact.

The counter was invoked with the r58 driver (scripts/chrome-cdp-loopback-round58.mjs) and no --expect-driver-sha256; the refusal short-circuits before any driver read, which is why the absent receipt dominates the output.
No browser was launched and no network was touched by this probe.
